description: This source file provides implementations for parsing various data types and values, including signed integers, unsigned integers, doubles, and boolean values, with support for unit suffixes. It also includes functions for parsing environment variables into boolean or unsigned long types. The file appears to be part of a larger project related to Git, given the naming conventions and included headers.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as a signed integer with optional unit suffix, validating against a maximum value.

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned integer with optional unit suffix, validating against a maximum value.

methods.name: int git_parse_int64(const char * value,int64_t * ret)

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
